text: INTERPRETER + RESOLVER (S7-UnsealedParity-1,6,7,8,9, S7-Seal-2): frame_edge's loop-control text comes from FrameEdge::loop_control_escape, so a handler arm reads "`break`/`continue` cannot leave an effect-handler arm (a loop around the `with` is not the arm's loop)" (other edges unchanged); the resolver's refinement-name rule takes checker::DEFERRED_PREFIXES as exact names (v0.22's prefix rule predates amendment 117), so `type GoalScore = i64 where …` is accepted and `type Goal = …` refused, and the duplicate-impl E0002 prints checker::axon_type_name; TEST_ENDED_ON_FAILURE names an early None; run_test_fn returns Err on TestEnd::failure_exit, so improve.rs G3 reads axon test's verdict; vm run_test_body runs a test body holding its own Op::Return on the tree (the eager VM read an early return as a completion); depth_exceeded decides seal_call first (v0.22 order). Unsealed behaviour change: the handler-arm and early-None panic/failure texts, refinement names that merely start with Uncertain/Temporal/Goal/Dict now resolve, the duplicate-impl text, axon improve's G3 verdict on an Err/early-None test, and AXON_VM_EAGER=1 test completion after an early return (now as the tree); spec §3 declares the v0.22 rows; sealed runs: a depth-limit call of an operator fn reads the uniform no-such-fn text
